title: Irreversible Diff Badge
summary: Marks fields that can't be changed back and, before save, lists only the permanent fields that actually changed, from → to.
description: Chip for permanent fields that turns amber once edited, plus a pre-save readback listing only the permanent fields that changed (from → to) with consequences and one-tap Revert, behind a confirmation that resets whenever that list changes.
catches: Permanent or rarely changeable fields edited without notice
Readback of only the hard-to-undo fields that changed, with consequences
Confirmation given for one set of changes reused for another: it resets
limits: You decide which fields are permanent; it can't know
Comparison uses your equals or a strict/JSON comparison
a11y: Readback is a labelled group described by the change list
Changes are announced in a polite live region; from/to are read as text, with del/ins visuals aria-hidden
Revert buttons have aria-labels naming the field and old value; focus moves after a revert
server: Enforce which fields are immutable on the server and audit-log changes to them.
